workload.variant: V1, FP32, fixed population, detail recipe
workload.initialization: Mac-prepared supplied cameras and training-only 1280-pixel feature seeds; no optimized Mac checkpoint imported

quality.reserved_view_selection: Same six views reused for development selection; not blind benchmark.

verification.independent_mac_rerender: All six native per-view metrics and exported render/target pixel arrays reproduced exactly.
verification.network_state_evidence: Tester confirmed personally observing the network-disabled state.

conditions: Release, no debugger, foreground, offline, unplugged, brightness approximately 50%.
Thermal categories report OS pressure, not Celsius or direct GPU clock/throttling measurements.
Coarse whole-device battery estimates began at full charge; no idle-screen baseline or precise energy/power measurement.
Process peak is sampled; Metal allocations overlap unified system/process memory.
Single development scene and recipe, not a general phone-quality or battery-life guarantee.
privacy: Public DTU benchmark only. Personal signing/device/account identifiers, private captures, absolute paths and wall-clock activity timestamps are omitted.
